''See also: [[Rosegold continent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Rosegold]] continent is a significant landmass within the world of [[Cradle]], historically recognized as the center of human power. It has been shaped by the influence of powerful lineages, most notably [[Arelius family|House Arelius]], which once ruled over half of the continent until the downfall of its patriarch, [[Tiberian Arelius]]. Currently, the territory is under the dominion of [[Reigan Shen]], the Emperor of Lions and [[Monarch]] of the [[Rosegold]] continent. A native of the western plains, [[Reigan Shen]] is a [[sacred beast]] who rose to power by uniting his pride and establishing his own unique [[Path]]. The continent's history is steeped in legend, including tales of a mythical buried city that supposedly holds the secrets to the [[sacred arts]] and effortless [[advancement]]. While much of its political landscape has been defined by the struggle between great Houses, [[Reigan Shen]]'s rise represents a shift in [[Authority|authority]]. The continent has also been a site of immense conflict, having suffered destruction during rare battles between [[Monarchs]]. Geographically, it is situated near the [[Iceflower Continent|Iceflower continent]] and serves as a major territory in the global landscape of power.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Rosegold]] continent is the ancestral home of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]], which formerly held rule over much of the vast territory. Currently, the continent is governed by Emperor [[Reigan Shen]]. Within these lands lie the western plains, which serve as the birthplace of the Emperor's pride.}}
